a.lede: The open-source AnyPS5 project has reached 100% GPU shader instruction coverage.
a.title: AnyPS5 project reaches critical GPU milestone in race to enable running PS5 games natively on PC

b.lede: RafaelNGP released a native Xbox Game Pass app allowing Xbox Cloud Gaming on the PS5, with support for 4 controllers and 4K upscaling on the PS5 GPU.
b.title: Developer uses Claude to enable Xbox Cloud Gaming on jailbroken PS5s
